questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{因为} \sum_{i=1}^{n} (X_i-\overline{X})^2 &= \sum_{i=1}^{n} X_i^2 - n \overline{X}^2, \ E(\overline{X}) = E(X), \ D(\overline{X}) = \frac{1}{n} D(X), \ \text{所以} \\ E \sum_{i=1}^{n} (X_i-\overline{X})^2 &= E \sum_{i=1}^{n} X_i^2 - E \left( n \overline{X}^2 \right) = n E(X^2) - n E(\overline{X}^2) \\ &= n (D(X) + (E(X))^2 - D(\overline{X}) - (E(\overline{X}))^2) \\ &= (n-1) D(X). \\ ES_i^2 &= E\big( \frac{1}{2} \sum_{i=1}^{2} (X_i-\overline{X})^2 \big) = E\big( \frac{1}{2} \cdot \frac{1}{2} \sum_{i=1}^{2} (X_i-\overline{X})^2 \big) = \frac{1}{2} D(X) = \frac{1}{2} \sigma^2. \end{aligned}
